study_design: Clinic-based case-control study of newly diagnosed, histologically confirmed prostate cancer cases and cancer-free controls.
reason: The reported serum folate estimate concerns prostate cancer regardless of grade. The only grade-specific result mentioned is a weak gene effect for low-grade disease, which is nonaggressive; no incident aggressive folate association is established.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Serum folate concentration showed a positive association with prostate cancer (OR, 4.41; CI, 2.52-7.72 per 10 nmol/L) regardless of grade.
estimate_classifications.reason: The phrase 'regardless of grade' identifies this as an overall prostate cancer estimate, not an aggressive endpoint.
